model.specification: yi = mu + ui + ei; ui ~ N(0,tau2), ei ~ N(0,vi), independent across retained rows and between components. Constrain tau2 >= 0 and estimate by REML. For a fixed tau2, wi=1/(vi+tau2), mu=sum(wi*yi)/sum(wi), SE(mu)=sqrt(1/sum(wi)).
model.reproducible_objective: Minimize 0.5*[sum(log(vi+tau2))+log(sum(wi))+sum(wi*(yi-mu)^2)] over tau2>=0, including the boundary. checks.py compares numerical minimization with the analytic REML score root.
model.uncertainty_convention: Declare two-sided normal Wald 95% CI: mu +/- 1.95996398454*SE; z test of mu=0. Source examples leave defaults implicit and the earlier instrument was not supplied. Match its uncertainty convention before claiming exact replication; Hartung-Knapp or prediction intervals are different outputs.
model.R_reference: reference.R uses metafor::rma.uni(yi=yi, vi=vi, data=e, method="REML", test="z", level=95), checks escalc pass-through and numerical agreement, and records versions. Rscript is unavailable, so this package check remains pending.

independence_and_ambiguity: Retain 19 rows for numerical reproduction, conditional on independent effects and applicable variances. Unique study numbers do not prove independence.

Studies 4/5 share Pellegrini & Hicks (1972), weeks=0, n1i=11, n2i=22, but differ in tester and yi. Obtain participant/arm/control/outcome identities; do not merge, drop or certify independence from labels. [TT:5-6]
The 1984 title says 18 experiments; the table/documentation has 19 studies/rows. Request an experiment-to-effect crosswalk; do not assume the repeated-author pair explains this. [TM:5,27,34; TT:1-20]

Verify allocation units, teacher/classroom/school clustering, shared controls, repeated outcomes and previous variance adjustment. Dependence requires covariance/design evidence or justified independent-effect selection; changing the model requires a fresh specification.
Obtain exact SMD correction/denominator and IQ test/timepoint per effect. The eight-month Pygmalion example does not establish a common follow-up. [TM:25,29]

It checks IDs/schema, finite effects, positive variances/sample sizes, SE rounding, time/categories, repeated labels, and REML objective versus score. Solvers agree within 6e-10 in tau2. Run Rscript assay/recipient_e/reference.R <absolute-study-base> when R/metafor is available; it checks agreement at 1e-6. The declared 95% interval includes zero; it does not establish a positive pooled effect.

crop_disposition.conditional_physical_derivation: For independent arms, yi=mean_T-mean_C in kg/ha; vi=SD_T^2/n_T+SD_C^2/n_C in (kg/ha)^2. For n complete matched pairs, vi=(SD_T^2+SD_C^2-2*r*SD_T*SD_C)/n, requiring pairing and r or SD of paired differences. Clustered/adjusted designs need appropriate contrast variances. The notebook cannot verify these prerequisites.
crop_disposition.executable_gate_plan: With actual data: assert finite means/SDs, SD>=0, n>1 for sample SDs, explicit units/sign and positive finite variances; recompute selected source rows; reconcile counts and shared arms using trial IDs. Fit the SAME explicit intercept-only REML/z-95% reference to a justified independent MD set. Stop for unresolved units, estimand, dependence, counts or variances; never invent observations.
